magento-checkout-automation.title: Magento Checkout Automation
magento-checkout-automation.summary: Guest-checkout E2E against Magento 2, the portfolio's reference suite: profile-driven scenarios, store-safe smoke tagging, and living Serenity reports published to Pages.

orangehrm-pim-automation.title: OrangeHRM PIM Automation
orangehrm-pim-automation.summary: Add-employee journeys through the OrangeHRM PIM module, driven against a Dockerised, seeded instance so the suite is deterministic in CI, with Serenity living docs on Pages.

parabank-bank-automation.title: ParaBank Bank Automation
parabank-bank-automation.summary: Docker-backed ParaBank automation combining Serenity/JS and Playwright UI journeys with stateful API BDD, live OpenAPI validation, and REST–SOAP parity.

bfx-ws-screenplay.title: Bitfinex WebSocket Screenplay
bfx-ws-screenplay.summary: Tests the live Bitfinex public WebSocket API v2 with an in-house, chainable Screenplay layer — including a flagship CRC-32 order-book checksum verified against consecutive live frames. Specification-driven, one SPEC unit at a time.

hand-baked-screenplay-pattern.title: Hand-Baked Screenplay Pattern
hand-baked-screenplay-pattern.summary: A dependency-free TypeScript implementation of the Screenplay Pattern, following the Serenity/JS design model from scratch — actors, abilities, tasks, questions — with a pure event-fold static HTML reporter. A teaching reference, released as 0.2.0.

markdown-renderer.title: Markdown Renderer
markdown-renderer.summary: A static, offline, browser-based Markdown viewer: pick a folder, browse a drilldown tree, read the rendered pane. Vendored dependencies, sanitised render, works over file://. Tested with Vitest units and Playwright E2E.

mobile-forex-automation.title: Mobile Forex Automation
mobile-forex-automation.summary: A deterministic responsive forex demo exercised through Pixel 7 and iPhone 14 emulation: touch-first Screenplay journeys, exact seeded-price and P&L oracles, and on-device breakpoint and overflow checks.

calculator-screenplay-bdd.title: Calculator Screenplay BDD
calculator-screenplay-bdd.summary: A calculator API exercised through playwright-bdd and a Screenplay layer, with an OpenAPI contract exposed by the service. Demonstrates BDD at the API tier and consumer-facing contract discipline.

gb.automation.smoketests.sudoku.poc.title: Sudoku Multi-Stack Parity POC
gb.automation.smoketests.sudoku.poc.summary: The same Sudoku smoke suite implemented three ways — TypeScript/Cucumber.js, Python/pytest-bdd, C#/Reqnroll — with automated cross-stack parity checks proving the same 48-scenario contract stays in lock-step across all three. A study in test-suite portability.

portfolio-prompts.title: portfolio-prompts
portfolio-prompts.summary: provides the shared registry, lifecycle prompts, templates, and agent-agnostic handover conventions behind these showcases.
